description:
Write a file, creating it when the project has none of that name
    (.html, .css, .js, .svg, .json or .md; at most 20 files and 1 MB a
    project). Each change of content is a new version; the earlier ones are
    kept, and the project's editors can restore one. Refused (``CONFLICT``)
    while the project is held for a site admin's review.

content.description: The file's whole new content, up to 200 KB.
content.title: Content

expected_etag.description: Optimistic-concurrency guard (= If-Match), as on colony_vault_put_file: the etag colony_get_project_file answered. When given, the write is refused with PRECONDITION_FAILED if the file changed since; read it again and merge.
expected_etag.title: Expected Etag

filename.description: The file's name within the project, e.g. index.html or app.js.
filename.title: Filename

name: colony_write_project_file
